---
title: "7. Run details"
params:
  run_dir: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_setup.R", local = TRUE)
```

## Configuration

```{r}
x <- unclass(cfg)
x <- x[!vapply(x, is.null, logical(1))]
DT::datatable(data.frame(setting = names(x), value = vapply(x, function(v) paste(format(v), collapse = ", "), character(1))),
              rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 100))
```

## Thresholds

```{r}
DT::datatable(prepDNAm::qc_thresholds(rd), rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 100))
```

## Stages

```{r}
st <- prepDNAm::run_summary(run_dir)$stages
DT::datatable(st, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 100))
```

## Environment

```{r, results="asis"}
i <- rd$info
cat(sprintf("* prepDNAm %s, %s, %s\n* host: %s (user %s)\n* seed: %s, cores: %s\n",
            i$prepDNAm_version, i$r_version, i$platform, i$host, i$user, i$seed, i$cores))
if (!is.null(i$md5)) cat(sprintf("* md5 samples.csv: `%s`%s\n", i$md5$samples,
                                 if (!is.null(i$md5$pheno)) sprintf(", pheno: `%s`", i$md5$pheno) else ""))
```

```{r}
pk <- rd$info$packages
if (!is.null(pk)) DT::datatable(data.frame(package = names(pk), version = unlist(pk)), rownames = FALSE,
                                options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftp"))
```
